requirements.title: Procedure reference establishes dummy-to-effective argument association
requirements.definition: Execution of a procedure reference establishes correspondence between each actual argument and dummy argument and association between each present dummy argument and its effective argument; sequence association is one form of argument association.

requirements.title: Dummy argument name is the procedure-local access name for the effective argument
requirements.definition: A dummy argument name may differ from the effective argument name. The dummy argument name is the name by which the effective argument is known and accessed in the referenced procedure.

requirements.title: Argument associations from one procedure reference terminate at return and new invocations can associate different effective arguments
requirements.definition: Upon termination of a procedure reference, all argument associations established by that reference terminate. A dummy argument can be associated with a different effective argument in a later invocation.
